title: Bitcoin Policy Institute Renames to Finney Foundation for Open Technology
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Policy Institute Renames to Finney Foundation for Open Technology The Bitcoin Policy Institute said Tuesday it is now the Finney Foundation for Open Technology, a parent organization whose brief spans open-source AI, digital cash and encrypted messaging, with bitcoin remaining a primary focus. This post Bitcoin Policy Institute Renames to Finney Foundation for Open Technology first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
